angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 486,990 km at 105.64 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 9.4659 +/- 0.0177 mas (same row, RUWE 0.94): 105.64 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.7 +/- 0.01 solar radii from de Leon et al. 2021, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-346 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021MNRAS.508..195D/abstract): 486,990 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.71 +/- 0.02 solar masses from de Leon et al. 2021, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-346 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021MNRAS.508..195D/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4801 +/- 49 K from de Leon et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-346 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021MNRAS.508..195D/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: de Leon et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-346 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021MNRAS.508..195D/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/k2-346.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.599, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-346 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.18 dex, from de Leon et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021MNRAS.508..195D/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-346 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.66264, from Pope et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016MNRAS.461.3399P/abstract)
ageSource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 677884760027950080, flags_flame 00: age_flame 13.146997 Gyr (16th to 84th percentiles 10.44474 to 13.5)
